messages:
Sam F: Hey team — running the CloudMeterX trial invoice and noticed a weird line item: an "ingest GB" charge that doesn't match our usage expectations. tagging procurement and infra. @Eli P @Tina P

Eli P: thanks Sam. can you paste the raw line? sometimes their SKU mapping lumps pre-processing & upload together.

Sam F: sure — here's the row from the invoice PDF (manually transcribed):
```
SKU: CMX-INGEST-GB
Unit price: $0.50 / GB
Quantity: 1024
Line total: $512.00
Notes: dataset-ingest-prod (job-342)
```
This seems high and our CloudStorage logs show ~120GB for that day.

Tina P: oof. two possibilities: (1) their ingestion meter counts both compressed and uncompressed bytes, or (2) they double-count egress when ingest pipeline crosses regions. i asked CloudMeterX for metering docs last week, haven't got them back.

Maya A: from accounting: our trial credit was applied but rounding logic caused a $480 invoice balance. procurement will need to confirm prorate/credits before we approve.

Eli P: @procurement-bot can you pull the billing CSV from CloudMeterX for the trial org? need the raw metered events to reconcile with our storage logs. also check invoice "metering_window" field if present.

procurement-bot: fetching billing CSV for org:redwood-trial — available at https://s3.company/pmx/cloudmeterx/trial-182712.csv (processing) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam F: pasted a sample of the CSV rows I got from the bot — looks like ingestion events are counted per-file-chunk at 256MB, not per-GB, so multiple chunks per file ballooned quantity. Example row: `event_type=ingest size_bytes=268435456 chunks=1` repeated many times.

Tina P: that explains the delta. two follow-ups: (a) ask them to provide pricing mapping for chunk-based billing vs per-GB, and (b) request a one-off credit for trial mismatch — we shouldn't be charged full prod rates for repeated chunked uploads.

Eli P: Agreed. I'll open a procurement ticket asking for: metering spec, proof of chunk-to-GB conversion, and a trial-credit adjustment. Drafting now.

Maya A: please cc finance ops@redwood on the ticket. Also include the invoice number and the rounded balance so we can hold payment.

Sam F: thanks — tagging for visibility: @Tina P @Eli P @Maya A. If they push back, we may ask for a short-term SKU mapping change (e.g., CMX-INGEST-GB -> CMX-INGEST-GB-UNCOMPRESSED) so future charges match actual bytes.

Eli P: filing ticket: PMX-REQ-4873 — "Clarify ingest metering + request trial credit". ETA vendor response 48–72 hrs. Will update thread. :spiral_calendar:
